name: Raven Hill Cemetery
summary: At Raven Hill Cemetery, the dead rise from their graves in western Duskwood. The burial ground once served nearby hamlets, but now undead, spiders, and grave robbers roam among the tombs.

sections.title: A Garden of the Restless Dead
sections.body: Raven Hill Cemetery was once the burial ground for the settlements around the Dawning Wood. When dark sorceries fell upon the region, the dead began clawing out of their plots. Skeletons, ghouls, and shambling horrors now crowd the graveyard. Rotting abominations and giant spiders prowl among the tombs, while desperate grave robbers plunder ancestral crypts beyond the reach of local authorities. Raven Hill remains one of Duskwood's most dangerous places.

sections.title: Restless Spirits and Dark Powers
sections.body: Morgan Ladimore patrols the headstones as Mor'Ladim, a mindless skeletal horror. The fallen knight took his own life amid madness and sorrow. On the rises of Forlorn Rowe, north of the cemetery, the necromancer Morbent Fel draws on the graves' foul energy to raise and bind legions of undead. Near the cemetery's northeastern edge, Abercrombie the hermit watches from his secluded shack at the edge of the mist.

faq.q: Why are so many undead rising in Raven Hill Cemetery?
aliases: who raised the dead in raven hill
faq.answer: Dark corruption spread through the cemetery when Duskwood was blighted, and necromantic power seeped into the earth. Morbent Fel works from Forlorn Rowe, twisting that power to raise and control the dead.
Mor'Ladim is a skeletal revenant who patrols the graveyard and attacks travelers. His identity and past come to light through an investigation in Darkshire.

faq.q: Where is Morbent Fel located in the cemetery?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel dwells atop Forlorn Rowe, in the northwestern corner of Raven Hill Cemetery. From a decrepit house overlooking the tombstones, he directs the undead around him.

faq.q: Who is the hermit living on the edge of the cemetery?
faq.answer: Abercrombie is the hermit who lives in a ramshackle hut near the cemetery's northeastern borders. Frail and eccentric, he often asks passing travelers to gather strange components and ingredients for his morbid projects.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face graves and corruption that call for holy consecration.
As a priest, you find shadow and sorrow in these graves, a bleak reminder of spirits denied passage to the Light.
